lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A matrix of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately nine discernible vertical columns and five horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, forming a structured grid-like 2D spatial distribution across the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, acting as anchor nodes that define the geometric regularity of the lateral patterning.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, each defined by a sharp vertical pixel gradient consisting of high-intensity specular highlights on the dorsal-facing edge and low-intensity shadows on the ventral-facing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Two elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (commensal remoras) are visible positioned ventrally beneath the shark's midsection.
